name: Microphone
author: Tulpar Control
description: The light bar glows red while Windows' microphone is muted, so you don't talk into a muted call. It can also glow while an app is listening, and Mute switches the microphone off and on. Apps with their own mute button (Discord, Teams) mute only themselves, which Windows doesn't see.

settings.label: Glow while muted
options: Only while an app uses the microphone

settings.label: Glow while an app listens
settings.description: While the microphone is on and an app uses it, as Windows' microphone icon in the taskbar shows.
